stem.text: Two objects X and Y form an isolated system. X and Y collide and then separate. The mass of X is greater than the mass of Y.
Which statement about the collision is correct?

A.text: The change of momentum of Y is greater than the change of momentum of X.

B.text: The force on Y is greater than the force on X.

C.text: The forces that X and Y exert on each other act for the same length of time.

D.text: The forces that X and Y exert on each other are gravitational forces only.
